name: Attai
title: Descendant of Jerahmeel and Sheshan
summary: Attai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel. He was the son of Sheshan's daughter and the Egyptian servant Jarha, and became part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. There is also another Attai who was one of David's warriors from the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: Sheshan's Daughter Married to Jarha
keyEvents.description: Sheshan, having no sons, gave his daughter in marriage to his Egyptian servant Jarha, and she bore Attai.

keyEvents.title: Attai's Place in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Attai is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah as the father of Nathan, through whom the family line continues.

keyEvents.title: Gadite Warriors Join David
keyEvents.description: Another Attai is mentioned among the brave warriors from the tribe of Gad who joined David in the wilderness when he fled from Saul.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Attai belongs to the broader lineage of Jerahmeel, which is an important branch of the tribe of Judah in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: The Connection between Israelites and Egyptians
keyEvents.description: Attai's origin through the Egyptian servant Jarha shows how foreigners could be incorporated into Israel's tribal community.
